scope: Counts on the listed captures, never rates. One capture = one incident; streams, Delta and policies are replays of it.

reasons: poller: fault manipulation not confirmed: latency_effect_established=False
watch: fault manipulation not confirmed: latency_effect_established=False

h_d.statement: H-D, applied mechanically. Cells: stream complete, Delta in {30, 60} s, policies temporal_join and bitemporal_abstain F = 600 s. A capture is in E_P (E_W) if, with poller (watch) context, either policy ranks the truth Pod worse than hindsight in any of those cells: the pessimistic truth rank is higher than the hindsight reference's at the same Delta, or the truth Pod is absent while hindsight ranks it (summarize_captures.compare; 'absent counts as worse'); each observer is compared with its own hindsight reference. Verdict: refuted if E_W is non-empty (each capture's mechanism listed); else confirmed as a poller artefact if E_P is non-empty; else untested (never support).
h_d.reading: E_P is empty: the poller effect did not occur on these captures, so the watch had nothing to remove; reported as untested, never as support
h_d.expected_frequency: Expected frequency: under the poller the effect appeared in 1 of 5 included Phase-3 captures on complete records at Delta = 30 s and in 3 of 4 with the switch record missing (L-4). With 6 D1 captures E_P may well be small or empty on the complete stream; the missing-switch rows are secondary.

h_d_secondary_rows.reading: DESCRIPTIVE ONLY, never the H-D verdict: the H-D membership test applied to the secondary and sensitivity rows, over the same included D1 captures; a capture without the row (e.g. a watch switch variant not constructed) is in no set

switch_stream_definitions.poller: replay-policy-v1 build_capture_perturbations: missing_switch_poll drops every record revealing a transition at the instant of the first record showing a Pod of the changed service leaving ready (one poll); corrected_late_{3,10}s let those records arrive with the preceding state and add corrected versions available 3 / 10 s later
switch_stream_definitions.watch: defined on the event before cache materialisation: missing_switch_event withholds the first watch event revealing a Pod of the changed service leaving ready (its snapshot is not taken; later snapshots show the Pod's preceding version until its next event); corrected_late_event_{3,10}s let that event carry the preceding state, every snapshot materialised from it within 3 / 10 s being corrected at the event's acceptance + 3 / 10 s
switch_stream_definitions.watch_event: the bridge's own record-level rule applied to the event log (secondary observer): the revealing records at the switch instant (one socket read) are dropped / carry the preceding state
